result.summary: Independently re-verified all 12 REQ-195 acceptance criteria against the real lib/letflow/audit.ex, lib/letflow/audit/entry.ex, and the migration (not the design doc or prior gate reports). AC6: personally hand-traced do_verify_chain/2 (lib/letflow/audit.ex L271-286) -- confirmed the hash-recompute check is cond's first clause, evaluated before the prev_chain_hash linkage check; confirmed prev_chain_hash is field 11 of the 11 hashed fields (canonical_string/1); confirmed by hand that a prev_chain_hash-only tamper makes BOTH cond clauses true simultaneously, so clause order alone decides hash_mismatch vs chain_broken, and the shipped order produces the theoretically-correct hash_mismatch attribution. Found and ran test/letflow/audit_dispositions_test.exs's 'tampering a persisted entry's prev_chain_hash while leaving its own chain_hash untouched is reported as hash_mismatch' test, which independently proves the exact same scenario -- it passed. actor_id spot-check (4 operations, chosen for zero overlap with SECURITY-REVIEWER/REVIEWER's already-checked set): Engine.cancel_instance/3 (real, required attrs[:actor_id]), Identity.insert_token/3 (nil per design, token_hash excluded from after_state), TaskActivation.do_insert/3 (nil, OQ-1), plus re-grepped all 6 Identity actor_id:nil call sites -- zero discrepancies against the design's Sec3.2 table. Confirmed the BEFORE UPDATE/BEFORE DELETE immutability trigger is installed inside the tenant-scoped migration guard and the migration is registered in Letflow.TenantProvisioning.tenant_scoped_migrations/0 (lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex:469). Confirmed Ecto.Multi same-transaction guarantee at 2 real call sites (Identity.insert_token/3, Engine.run_cancel_instance/5) -- audit step Multi.merge'd into the same chain, one Repo.transaction() call. git diff main...HEAD --stat confirms zero lib/letflow/routers/ files touched (AC11) and confirms neither test/letflow/engine/lua/executor_test.exs nor test/mix/tasks/letflow_check_toolchain_test.exs is in this branch's diff. Ran the 4 target REQ-195 test files myself: 39/39 passed (9+5+11+14, exact file-by-file test counts). Ran scripts/test_parallel.sh myself (N=8, blocking foreground, no backgrounding): 2800/2802 passed, 2 failures, both Mix.Tasks.Letflow.CheckToolchainTest rust-pin :enoent (rustc genuinely absent from this host's PATH) -- same documented pre-existing flake class TEST-RUNNER named, no new regression. Ran mix compile --warnings-as-errors myself: clean, exit 0. Full independent basis: handoffs/WF02-REQ195-20260830/req195-release-validation-report.md.
